summary.text: Max Wolfley is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 95 since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Max Wolfley earned a degree from Oklahoma State University, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as teacher, coach and flooring contractor.
He took office on November 18, 2020, succeeding Kelly Albright, and Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignment as the Education Oversight Committee.
He advanced from the June 16, 2026 Republican primary and faces Tegan Malone, a Democrat, and Ryan Gardner, an independent, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
